description:
Wide Horizons (BETA)

Dependencies:

LunaLib, GraphicsLib and Particle Engine

Description

Important: v1.4.x is Not Save-Compatible with older version 1.3.x

Wide Horizons

lets you expand the Starsector galaxy by up to

300%

.

With

in-game setting

, the entire universe scales up: sector size, star systems, ruins, Remnants, gates, and more.

Major factions are redistributed across this vast space in a lore-consistent way, offering a fresh sense of exploration and strategic depth.

Key Features:

Bigger Galaxy (scalable):

Expand the sector up to 125-300% and tweak density right from the Settings.

Realistic systems:

Efforts are made to generate systems that are as realistic as possible.

SpoilerWide Horizons’ “Realistic Systems” option changes how newly generated, uninhabited star systems are built.

Instead of placing planets in a more random vanilla-style way, the mod tries to create systems that feel more believable and physically structured. It takes things like the star type, luminosity, habitable zone, snow line, system age, and orbital spacing into account.

In practice, this means:

hotter inner planets are more likely to be barren, irradiated, rocky, or volcanic

colder outer planets are more likely to be icy or frozen

habitable worlds are more likely to appear near the star’s habitable zone

gas giants usually form farther out, often beyond the snow line

asteroid belts, dust rings, ice rings, moons, and stable points are placed in more sensible locations

older or younger systems can have different structures, such as more debris, belts, or less stable planet layouts

The feature is meant to make exploration feel more natural and varied, while still staying close to Starsector’s vanilla style.

It does not rebuild important hand-made vanilla systems, core worlds, market systems, or most mod-added systems. It mainly affects random, unexplored procgen systems.[close]

Fuel scaling:

This allows you to better adjust your fuel consumption if you find it too difficult to reach remote locations.

Supply scaling:

This allows you to better adjust your supply compensation if you find it too difficult to reach remote locations.

Mission timer adjustment:

This scales the mission timer based on the size of the galaxy, giving you more time to reach distant locations.

Strange Hyperspace:

regions that change storms, visibility, and travel.

Discovery Gameplay:

Some systems start hidden; uncover them over time, earn small XP, and get clear messages. Can be turned on & off.

Hyperspace Music:

The custom Wide Horizons hyperspace music can be turned on or off at any time.

Performance Mode:

Generates a smaller, more performance-friendly sector while automatically adjusting its content to match the reduced size.

More Variety, Vanilla-friendly:

More ruins, remnants, salvage and points of interest kept close to the vanilla feel.

Huge Mod Support:

Fixed placement for 60+ popular mods so their systems land in sensible spots.

Dark Star Content (WIP):

Void & Pulse stars with unique hazards, pulses, and probes to find.

Storyline (WIP):

Follow the new storyline surrounding the AI faction "EidolON".

Custom Start (WIP):

"Black Project" start with a brief introduction and a survival-focused opening with a continuing story.

Wide Horizons now offers full support with

Customizable Star Systems!

Our internal helper reads all entries from customStarSystems.json using CSS’s own merge logic, and registers those systems for proper positioning and scaling in the expanded Wide Horizons sector.

CSS systems are matched by:

explicit "name" (first star) or matching "setLocation" coordinates

Systems without a name and without coordinates cannot be matched.
Please include one or both in your system definitions to enable Wide Horizons support.

changelog.1.4.1a:
Version 1.4.1a (August 2026)

Save compatible with 1.4.x

IMPORTANT: Please reset the settings when starting a new game, as some values have changed to their default settings

Modified:
Remnant generation adjusted and improved
Added mod support for "Project MISTRAL" to add scaling

Fixed:
Fixed Remnant generation with the Beacons
changelog.1.4.1:
Version 1.4.1 (July 2026)

Save compatible with 1.4.x

Modified:
    Luna Settings has been redesigned and made easier to understand
    Added a new performance mode for sector generation
    Added a small performance feature to turn the nebula on and off on the Starscape map for a little better performance
    Improved sector generation for better performance in all modes
    BladeBreaker and Agni are now scaled using the default values
    Old background textures removed
    Nebula generation has been adjusted and aligned with the Realistic generator
    The fuel compensation function has been adjusted
    Added a new feature for supply compensation
    Added a new feature to Custom Start to enable and disable alliance joining in the UAF
    Added a feature to disable the hyperspace music from Wide Horizons
    (other audio mods that change the hyperspace tracks are supported)

Fixed:
    Eidelon Fleet Fix for ARMAA Fleets
    Agni Mod ID fix
    System Fog is now generated correctly
changelog.1.4.0:
Version 1.4.0 (June 2026)

NOT Savegame compatible with 1.3.x

Modified:
    New Dark Star content added
    The mission/quest line system has been completely overhauled and restructured
    The EidolON faction is no longer displayed
    Changes to the Darkstar systems regarding their descriptions
    Void and Pulse damage now occurs only in Strange Hyperspace FX cells
    Old temporary sensor mods will be removed during the next script cleanup
    Only Procgen Systems = On
        - Only genuine vanilla/engine procgen systems are hidden.
    Only Procgen Systems = Off
        - Mod systems without a visible population market are also hidden.
    Black Project Custom Start
        - Increased mission timers for longer travel distances
        - Added separate outbound and return deadlines
        - Added mission payments, fuel, and supplies for the investigation
        - Improved mission cleanup after reporting findings
    The system generation has been improved so that planets can no longer form outside the system
    A feature has been added to import the externalized texts so that they can then be translated
   Support for the Old China Version from RAT v2.6.10

    New systems that are supported
        - 40k Banished Imperium
        - REDACTED *** PACK
        - Navarchy of Tania

Fixed:
    Mission sequence fixed
    Performance fixes and adjustments to functions that can no longer be loaded twice
    No longer applies a persistent debuff after exiting
    No longer deals Pulse Storm damage in normal star systems
    No longer causes random hits due to coordinate overlap between hyperspace and star systems
    Fixed repeated "Report Findings" option after mission completion
    The Remnants warning beacon has been adjusted and fixed

A huge thank you to "Reshy" and "nicholas_cox" for submitting so many reports
